Example Marker Map

Source: R/example_data.R
gs_example_marker_map.Rd

Genomic coordinates, alleles, and simulated LD-block membership for the 240 columns of `gs_example_geno`.

Usage

gs_example_marker_map

Format

A data frame with 240 rows and six columns:

SNP

Unique marker identifier.

CHR

Chromosome number (1, 2, or 3).

POS

Base-pair position, increasing within chromosome.

REF

Reference allele.

ALT

Alternate allele counted by the dosage matrix.

Block

Known simulated block identifier, such as `C1B1`.

Source

Generated by `data-raw/generate_example_data.R`.

Examples

data(gs_example_marker_map)
head(gs_example_marker_map)
#>       SNP CHR   POS REF ALT Block
#> 1 S1_0001   1 11191   A   C  C1B1
#> 2 S1_0002   1 12649   A   G  C1B1
#> 3 S1_0003   1 14015   A   T  C1B1
#> 4 S1_0004   1 14618   C   G  C1B1
#> 5 S1_0005   1 15739   C   T  C1B1
#> 6 S1_0006   1 17021   G   T  C1B1
table(gs_example_marker_map$CHR, gs_example_marker_map$Block)
#>    
#>     C1B1 C1B2 C1B3 C1B4 C2B1 C2B2 C2B3 C2B4 C3B1 C3B2 C3B3 C3B4
#>   1   20   20   20   20    0    0    0    0    0    0    0    0
#>   2    0    0    0    0   20   20   20   20    0    0    0    0
#>   3    0    0    0    0    0    0    0    0   20   20   20   20
